name: algomo
description: Manage an Algomo workspace: read your chatbots' customer conversations, edit chatbots, knowledge base and workflows, test changes and publish them.

interface.longDescription:
Algomo is an AI customer-conversation platform: chatbots that talk to your website visitors, capture leads, answer from your knowledge base and book meetings.

With this plugin you can work on your Algomo workspace from ChatGPT:

- Read what customers asked your chatbots and how the chatbots answered.
- Review and edit chatbots: instructions, goals, tools and capabilities.
- Keep the knowledge base up to date.
- Build and run workflows and custom agents.
- Send a chatbot a test message to see how it replies.

Configuration changes are staged in an edit session, so you can review and test them before anything goes live. Publishing is a separate step.

You need an Algomo account. The plugin acts on the workspace you choose when you connect.
defaultPrompt: What did customers ask my Algomo chatbot this week?
Add a page about our returns policy to my Algomo knowledge base.
Send my Algomo chatbot a test message asking about pricing.

positive.prompt: Which chatbots do I have in Algomo, and which one is the default?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the chatbots in the connected workspace by name and says which one is the default.

positive.prompt: What have customers been asking my Algomo chatbot recently? Summarise the last few conversations.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recent customer conversations, reads several of them and summarises what the customers asked.

positive.prompt: What pages are in my Algomo knowledge base? Read me the one about shipping.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the knowledge base pages with their titles, then reads the shipping page and reports what it says.

positive.description: Send a chatbot a test message
positive.prompt: Send my Algomo chatbot a test message asking how much shipping costs, and show me what it replies.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the chatbot, sends the test message and shows the chatbot's reply. The conversation is recorded as a test conversation.

positive.description: Stage a knowledge base change and publish it
positive.prompt: Update the "Opening hours" page in my Algomo knowledge base to say we are closed on 25 and 26 December. Show me what will change before you publish it.
positive.tools_triggered: list_knowledge_base_pages, get_knowledge_base_page, create_session, update_knowledge_base_page, get_session_changes, publish_session
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Opening hours page, opens an edit session, stages the updated content, shows the staged change and asks for confirmation. After the user confirms, publishes the session and reports that the change is live.

negative.description: A general question that has nothing to do with Algomo
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Australia?

negative.description: A coding task with no Algomo workspace involved
negative.prompt: Write a Python function that reverses a string.
Draft a LinkedIn post announcing that we are hiring a designer.

publication.release_notes: First release: read conversations, edit chatbots, knowledge base and workflows, test and publish.
